questions.question: 1. What is the main purpose of unfreezing the last layers in Transfer Learning?

answers.a: To allow the model to adapt high-level features to the target dataset
answers.b: To permanently delete the pretrained backbone
answers.c: To stop training in the network
answers.d: To increase the dataset size automatically

explanations.a: Correct because deeper layers capture complex task-specific patterns, so unfreezing them improves adaptation to the new dataset.
explanations.b: Incorrect because transfer learning uses the pretrained backbone, it does not delete it.
explanations.c: Incorrect because unfreezing layers is done to enable learning, not to stop it.
explanations.d: Incorrect because unfreezing layers does not increase dataset size.

questions.question: 2. If training accuracy is very high but validation accuracy is low, it indicates:

explanations.a: Incorrect because perfect performance means both training and validation accuracy are high.
explanations.b: Incorrect because underfitting happens when both training and validation accuracy are low.
explanations.c: Correct because the model learns training patterns too well but fails to generalize.
explanations.d: Incorrect because preprocessing is still required for good performance.

questions.question: 3. Why is a smaller learning rate preferred during fine-tuning?

answers.b: To avoid large weight updates that can damage pretrained features
answers.d: To remove the need for backpropagation

explanations.a: Incorrect because memory usage is not directly controlled by learning rate.
explanations.b: Correct because fine-tuning requires small updates to preserve useful pretrained weights.
explanations.c: Incorrect because learning rate does not affect dataset size.
explanations.d: Incorrect because training always uses backpropagation.

answers.b: Freezing all backbone layers and training only the added classifier layers

explanations.a: Incorrect because base freeze does not train the whole backbone again.
explanations.b: Correct because the backbone works as a fixed feature extractor and only the new layers learn.
explanations.c: Incorrect because classifier layers are required for prediction.
explanations.d: Incorrect because image resizing is done in preprocessing.

questions.question: 5. Unfreezing 20% of the last layers mainly helps in:

answers.a: Learning only basic edges and textures
answers.c: Learning task-specific patterns for the target dataset
answers.d: Converting the CNN into an SVM model

explanations.a: Incorrect because basic features are learned in early layers.
explanations.b: Incorrect because unfreezing layers does not change batch size.
explanations.c: Correct because deeper layers learn complex features that are more target-dependent.
explanations.d: Incorrect because unfreezing does not change the algorithm type.

questions.question: 6. Which pretrained CNN model generally requires higher computational resources during transfer learning?

explanations.a: Incorrect because MobileNetV2 is designed as a lightweight and efficient CNN architecture for mobile and low-resource devices.
explanations.b: Incorrect because EfficientNetB0 is optimized to achieve good accuracy with fewer parameters and lower computation compared to heavier CNN models.
explanations.c: Incorrect because although ResNet50 is deeper and computationally heavier than MobileNetV2, it is still generally less resource-intensive than VGG19.
explanations.d: Correct because VGG19 contains a very large number of parameters and convolutional layers, making it computationally expensive in terms of memory and training time.

questions.question: 7. Which plot best helps in checking training performance and overfitting?

explanations.a: Incorrect because file names do not show training behaviour.
explanations.b: Incorrect because random scatter plots do not reflect model learning.
explanations.c: Incorrect because confusion matrix is useful after predictions, not before training.
explanations.d: Correct because these curves show learning progress and generalization issues.

questions.question: 8. If validation loss increases while training loss decreases, it usually means:

explanations.a: Incorrect because underfitting means training loss is also high.
explanations.b: Incorrect because increasing validation loss indicates poor generalization.
explanations.c: Correct because the model fits training data well but performs worse on unseen validation data.
explanations.d: Incorrect because training cannot proceed properly without images.

questions.question: 9. What is the purpose of the Softmax layer in CNN classification?

answers.d: To convert outputs into probabilities over classes

explanations.a: Incorrect because pooling is mainly used for reducing spatial size.
explanations.b: Incorrect because normalization is a preprocessing step, not Softmax.
explanations.c: Incorrect because convolution layers learn edge detectors.
explanations.d: Correct because Softmax outputs a probability distribution across multiple classes.

explanations.d: Correct because irrelevant transferred knowledge harms target learning.
